capacity_policy_derivation.safety_margin_basis: 25 percent of pull-plus-conservative-unpack peak, rounded upward

limitations: The root-filesystem measurement is apparent-byte size rather than a streamed docker-export tar because Docker Desktop terminated repeated export streams without returning usable diagnostics; a full one-GiB representation reserve is added before the independent 25-percent safety margin.
Containerd overlay metadata and transient extraction behavior remain covered by the explicit reserves and the 40 GiB operational floor.
Any later image identity change requires another qualification and policy binding.

measurement.method: Run only /usr/bin/du as uid 0 in two stopped-after-measurement containers from the exact image, measure apparent root-filesystem bytes without starting the application, and add a one-GiB conservative archive-metadata, whiteout and overlay reserve.

measurement_note: Rebound from -002 for the pilot-5ebbaed rebuild: the only content change is one replaced ~12 KiB code layer (backends.py token-budget fix); archive bytes re-measured exactly; unpacked rootfs carried within byte-level margin; all derived requirements retain the same multi-GiB headroom against the 40 GiB operational floor.
required_controls: Validate the bound image archive bytes, conservative unpacked-rootfs upper bound, node root volume and operational floor before the attempt envelope.
Refuse without consuming an attempt when the configured GPU root volume is below the policy floor.
Keep model and evaluation artifacts on the separate encrypted 60 GiB work volume.
Do not change the 40 GiB managed node-group root volume without a reviewed AWS packet.
